pm: PM is an examination and dissection of a dead body to determine cause of death or the changes produced by disease.
PM can also mean a soft silvery metallic element of the rare earth group having no stable isotope.
PM can also mean the person who holds the position of head of the government in the United Kingdom.
PM means the same as autopsy or necropsy or postmortem.
pms: PMS is a syndrome that occurs in many women from 2 to 14 days before the onset of menstruation.
PMS means the same as premenstrual syndrome.
